entities.name: Build the executable semantic system kernel
entities.summary: Author and validate one reusable open-protocol component through direct and accepted-actor realizations.

acceptance: Semantic input and output categories remain distinct and schema-backed
Effect requests remain protocol data until an exact registered interpreter handles them
The bounded driver retains an exact causal trace and honest suspended work
Direct and accepted-actor inventory journeys normalize equally
Portable closure, Node and Bun parity, inherited regressions, and full repository gates pass
Reports preserve unsupported claims and evidence categories

relations.summary: The frozen tracer establishes the first executable realization of the component boundary.
The actor journey depends on the already accepted actor ownership and lifecycle contract.
The inventory tracer gains explicit pending request and returned-observation protocol state without changing accepted guards.
